$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-22 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-060. Order of the events of one day (FR-CAL-01, F-14; the legacy app sorted by colour name — intentionally changed). Needed on the client (day view, offline) and on the server (agenda, export, reminders later), hence two implementations against one contract.
purpose: Orders the entries shown on one day: all-day first, then by start time (an event continuing from an earlier day counts as 00:00 and comes first), then by title, then by creation time and key.

key.description: Unique per entry (event id + occurrence date).

continues.description: A timed entry that started on an earlier day of the viewer.

start.description: Start on this day in the viewer's zone (HH:MM); null for all-day entries; ignored when continues.

invariants: every all-day entry comes before every timed entry
all-day entries among themselves: by title (start is not used)
timed entries: effective start = 00:00 when continues, else start; earlier first; at the same effective start a continuing entry comes first

title comparison: first by the title key — Unicode NFKD, combining marks (category M) removed, lower-cased — so case and accents do not count ("apple" < "Banana", "Eagle" < "Éclair"); then by the title itself (code points)
then by created_at (earlier first), then by key — the order is total and stable
colour never takes part (the legacy colour-name order is gone)
